source: NCERT Class VIII, Our Pasts III, History Ch. 7.

sections.heading: 1. The Age of Social Reform
points: In the 19th century, reformers worked to end social evils affecting **women and lower castes** — **sati, child marriage, ban on widow remarriage, purdah, caste discrimination**.
They used **newspapers, books, and appeals to ancient texts and reason**.
Reform and colonial law together brought some change.

sections.heading: 2. Reforming the Lives of Women
points: **Raja Rammohan Roy** (founder of the **Brahmo Samaj, 1828**) campaigned against **sati**; **sati was banned in 1829** (by Lord William Bentinck).
**Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar** campaigned for **widow remarriage**; the **Widow Remarriage Act was passed in 1856**.
Reformers also promoted **girls' education** (e.g. schools by Vidyasagar, the Christian missionaries, and later by nationalists).
**Child marriage** was opposed (later the **Age of Consent** and **Sarda Act, 1929**).

sections.heading: 3. Caste and the Struggle for Equality
points: **Jyotirao Phule** (and **Savitribai Phule**) attacked caste injustice and founded the **Satyashodhak Samaj (1873)**; wrote **Gulamgiri**; started schools for girls and lower castes.
**E.V. Ramaswamy Naicker (Periyar)** led the **Self-Respect Movement** in the south against caste and Brahmin dominance.
**Dr B.R. Ambedkar** led the movement of the **'Depressed Classes' (Dalits)** for temple entry, wells and dignity; later shaped the Constitution.
Organisations like the **Prarthana Samaj, Arya Samaj (Dayananda Saraswati), Ramakrishna Mission (Vivekananda)** also worked for reform.

sections.heading: 4. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Raja Rammohan Roy = Brahmo Samaj (1828), campaign vs sati → sati banned 1829.
Vidyasagar = widow remarriage → Widow Remarriage Act 1856.
Jyotirao & Savitribai Phule = Satyashodhak Samaj (1873), Gulamgiri, girls'/lower-caste schools.
Periyar = Self-Respect Movement (south); Ambedkar = Dalit rights.
Reform bodies: Brahmo Samaj, Prarthana Samaj, Arya Samaj (Dayananda), Ramakrishna Mission (Vivekananda).

sections.heading: 5. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Sati banned in 1829** (Rammohan Roy + Bentinck); **Widow Remarriage Act 1856** (Vidyasagar).
**Brahmo Samaj = Rammohan Roy (1828)**; **Arya Samaj = Dayananda Saraswati**; **Satyashodhak Samaj = Jyotirao Phule (1873)**.
**Periyar** = Self-Respect Movement in the **south**.
**Savitribai Phule** = pioneer of **girls' education**.
